The '''Yag'Dhul shipyards''' were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] and circled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], homeworld of the [[Givin/Legends|Givins]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The shipyards were operated by the Givins who produced [[Starship/Legends|starships]] with a level of quality only matched by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]. Since most Givin can mentally calculate [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps, the starships manufactured in the Yag'Dhul shipyards were not equipped with [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. Members of other species who purchased Givin ships should therefore add such components.<ref name="GoI" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Givins provided their shipbuilding capacities to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="DB" />
